name: CMS, the Compact Muon Solenoid: Technical proposal
notes: Date recorded at year precision: the INSPIRE record returned no imprint date and CERN Document Server could not be read in this session, so the December 1994 submission month is not recorded.

summary.plain: The 1994 document in which the CMS team set out the detector it wanted to build at the Large Hadron Collider, and which CERN reviewed before approving the experiment.
summary.technical: CMS Technical Proposal submitted to the LHC Experiments Committee; the basis of the January 1996 approval of the experiment.
